summary: Iteration 21 (IFCT 2017 sourcing pass) fully verified. Backend 18 passed / 1 skipped (18/18 effective, meal-logs endpoint path skipped as non-iter21 concern). All 10 IFCT-sourced entries (Egg Yolk, Khoa/Mawa, Whole Egg, Muskmelon, Fig fresh, Ber, Bael, Phalsa, Radish, Water Chestnut) return exact spec values: potassium_mg / phosphorus_mg / sodium_mg + derived potassium_meq (0.5, 4.1, 7.5, 3.0, 6.1, 10.5, 9.3, 7.3, 9.8) and high_sodium=false. Source strings contain the correct IFCT codes (M006, L004, M004, E046, E020, E068, E008, E052, F012, F016). Iter-20 sodium regression intact — Jaljeera & Pani Puri still high_sodium=true. /api/foods, /api/auth login+me still 200. Legacy entries (Toor Dal, Apple, Bottle Gourd) carry no `source` field. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified end-to-end: /proteins Egg Yolk (alone) row shows 'K 0.5 mEq / 18 mg' with italic caption 'Source: IFCT 2017, code M006 (scaled to ~17 g)' at testID protein-row-egg-yolk-alone-source; Khoa/Mawa 'K 4.1 mEq / 161 mg' with L004 caption; /fruits Muskmelon 'K 7.5 mEq / 294 mg' with E046 caption; Ber, Fig fresh, Bael, Phalsa captions render; /vegetables Radish + Water Chestnut render with F012/F016 captions. Legacy Toor Dal / Apple / Bottle Gourd rows correctly show ZERO source caption (count=0). NOTE on K ordering: display shows mEq-first because demo user's nutrient_unit persists as 'mEq' from prior iterations — this is the iter-19 toggle working correctly; the raw mg value (18, 161, 294) is present and correct in both orderings.
critical_code_review_comments: protein_guide.py / fruit_guide.py / vegetable_guide.py: `source` and `phosphorus_mg` are plain pass-through fields — no hand-computed potassium_meq anywhere; enrich_guide remains the single source of derivation.

FoodGuideLayout.tsx GuideEntry type extends optional `source` + `phosphorus_mg`; sourceText style uses fontSize:11, italic, textSecondary — visually subtle as intended. Source caption testID `${testId}-source` is stable and matches the spec.

Guide docstrings updated in all three files to describe the IFCT sourcing convention + the dry-vs-cooked legume caveat. Toor Dal (78 mg / 60 g cooked) intentionally left as legacy cooked-value entry — correct per docstring.
